summary_zh: 已独立目检37段准确代表帧、13个最终回归样本以及13个首尾/转场抽查，共63个不同源帧；源像素可逆分区与语义拆净是不同验收。白衣填充、面包/胸针误分、幽灵误连等明显问题已改善，但字幕、接触道具、淡出、断开的手套和细线边界仍未全部拆净。本记录不是411张/4763帧逐帧美术验收。

equivalence.change_description: Only destination/temp symlink refusal checks in JSON and PNG output writers; splitter helpers and split_visible_frame unchanged.
equivalence.mask_hash_format: SHA-256 of C-order numpy bool bytes, height1080 x width1920 (one byte per pixel).
equivalence.scope: All 37 representative frames only; independent final13 regression samples rendered directly from frozen code.

coverage.source_only_selection_rule: first, middle and last panel for groups >6 panels; first panel otherwise; source-only does NOT certify output masks

review_method.contact_views: left=attachment1 RGB, middle=first nonempty subject/prop/unresolved/effects/letters layer, right=all other non-background layers; gray is display background only
scope_limits: Thin antialias/fringe pixels are not fully assessed at contact-sheet scale.
No unsupported clean matte, hidden drawing or author-cel identity claim.
A primary layer can contain attached lettering or props; its name is not a semantic acceptance.
Routing in each entry refers only to that exact representative; no nearest-panel pose substitution was used.

severity_definitions.none_observed: No visible foreground or no finding in the inspected sample; not whole-scene approval.
severity_definitions.low: No major semantic loss seen at inspected scale; edge/alpha review remains.
severity_definitions.medium: A material boundary, occlusion or combined-prop limitation remains.
severity_definitions.high: Large mixed regions, missing subject components or explicitly unsplit layouts prevent clean replacement.
